title: H-D CVO Street Glide 121 (Dark Edition)
description: Representing Harley-Davidson's engineering ethos in the Performance Cruiser class, the Harley-Davidson H-D CVO Street Glide 121 (Dark Edition) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
